description: Get details of a specific live stream. Returns {id, title, status, scheduled_at, stream_key, rtmp, live_hls, created_at}. Status: provisioning (channel starting), offline (waiting for signal or scheduled), online, finishing, finished, finished_imported (recording became a video), expired (no signal in time; can be regenerated). stream_key is a secret credential: show it only when the user asks for it (e.g. to set up OBS).
name: panda_get_live
title: Get Live
